content.user_title: Plan Safe Framework and Dependency Upgrades
content.value_statement: Dependency upgrades often fail when teams miss breaking changes, peer conflicts, or rollback steps. This skill creates structured upgrade plans with risk checks, tests, migration steps, and recovery guidance.
actual_capabilities: Assess npm and Python dependency update opportunities from package manager outputs.
Classify patch, minor, major, and unknown dependency updates.
Identify likely breaking changes from changelogs and known framework transitions.
Generate migration plans with branches, update steps, tests, and rollback actions.
Plan incremental upgrade paths and batch update groups.
Create compatibility, testing, and post-upgrade health check guidance.
limitations: It needs current dependency data, target versions, and project test commands.
It does not guarantee every breaking change or compatibility conflict is known.
Its examples emphasize npm and pip workflows.
Commands should be reviewed before use in production repositories.

use_cases.title: Upgrade a Frontend Framework
use_cases.description: Plan a React, Webpack, or similar major upgrade with breaking change review, tests, and rollback steps.

use_cases.title: Reduce Dependency Risk
use_cases.description: Prioritize security patches, low-risk minor updates, and delayed major migrations across a release cycle.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release-Safe Changes
use_cases.description: Build compatibility checks, validation commands, monitoring metrics, and recovery plans before dependency updates ship.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my project dependencies and create a priority matrix. Focus on security, stability, and low-risk updates.

prompt_templates.title: Plan One Major Upgrade
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan an upgrade from [framework] [current version] to [target version]. Include risks, tests, and rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create Incremental Migration Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to break [package] migration into safe stages. Include compatibility checks, peer dependencies, and validation commands.

prompt_templates.title: Review Upgrade Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review this upgrade branch. Compare dependency changes, expected breaking changes, test coverage, and rollback readiness.

output_examples.input: Upgrade React 17 to 18 in a production web app.
output_examples.output: Risk is medium because rendering and StrictMode behavior can change. The plan includes dependency updates, root rendering migration, focused tests, staging checks, and rollback steps.

output_examples.input: Review outdated npm and pip packages before a quarterly release.
output_examples.output: The priority matrix groups security patches first, minor updates second, and major framework upgrades last. Each group includes owners, tests, and rollback notes.

output_examples.input: Build a dependency compatibility report for a monorepo.
output_examples.output: The compatibility report highlights peer dependency conflicts, affected workspaces, required sequencing, and tests that validate each upgrade group.

best_practices: Start with patches and security updates before major migrations.
Create a rollback point and verify existing tests before editing dependencies.
Use official changelogs and migration guides for every major version change.
anti_patterns: Upgrade many unrelated major versions in one change set.
Skip lockfile review after package manager changes.
Treat passing unit tests as enough for framework behavior changes.

faq.question: Does this skill run upgrades automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gives plans and examples. Any command execution should remain under user control.

faq.question: Which package ecosystems does it cover?
faq.answer: The examples emphasize npm and pip, with general guidance useful for other package managers.

faq.question: Does it help with framework migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers breaking change analysis, codemods, testing, and rollback planning for framework upgrades.

faq.question: Can it replace official migration documentation?
faq.answer: No. Use it to organize work and cross-check official changelogs and migration guides.

faq.question: What inputs are most useful?
faq.answer: Provide current versions, target versions, lockfiles, changelogs, test commands, and release constraints.

faq.question: Is it safe for production projects?
faq.answer: It supports safer planning, but production changes still need code review, CI, staging validation, and monitoring.
